integrity: Self-contained mathematical proof and finite standard-library verifier; no independent mathematical validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: All parts must have equal positive size and all interpart payoffs must be one; heterogeneous interaction weights and unequal parts are not covered.
Pure Nash stability includes unilateral indifference. Mixed equilibria, dynamic selection, and robustness under payoff perturbations are not addressed.
All-size classification is proved analytically and tested on finite instances; finite tests alone are not exhaustive for arbitrary orders.
Potential unindexed equivalent results and an uninspected 2007 primary article remain literature-priority risks.
title: Exact equilibrium census on balanced complete multipartite networks
